race_name: L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France

top_categories.workout_context: Race-pace efforts that mimic L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before May.

Road-specific control matters at L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France. Practice on rolling closed roads around Encarnación: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 87 miles.
At mile 60 of 87, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France's rolling closed roads around Encarnación rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France. Train it until it feels boring.
When someone attacks on rolling closed roads around Encarnación, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.

Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France's rolling closed roads around Encarnación actually does to you.
2-minute all-out efforts on rolling closed roads around Encarnación. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 87 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 87 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France’s 87 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at L'Étape Encarnación by Tour de France rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on rolling closed roads around encarnación to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Race Simulation, Road Specific, and Durability to prepare you for 87 miles of rolling closed roads around encarnación in Encarnación, Itapúa, Paraguay.
